response.sql: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), ranked AS (SELECT race_counts.*, AVG(entry_count) OVER () AS average_entry_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY entry_count DESC) AS entry_rank FROM race_counts) SELECT raceId, country, total_points, entry_count, entry_count - average_entry_count AS difference_above_average FROM ranked WHERE entry_count > average_entry_count AND entry_rank <= 10 ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC, raceId;
